name: travelling-wave-capture
description: Arithmetic: a captured ion rides a moving well, so its transit is the distance over the WAVE's speed regardless of how fast it was injected. The wave speed is ringsPerWave x ringPitch x driveFrequency = 6 x 1 mm x 0.5 MHz = 3000 m/s over 27 mm, which is 9.0 us. Injected at half that speed. Run beside travelling-wave-ballistic, which gives 18.0 us with the wave off - the pair is what says the ion is carried rather than flying.
